geometry_edits.rationale: Transform the protected public-threshold node into a courtyard-forming macro so the street edge can become a legible public void rather than a sealed overhang.
Set a bounded courtyard margin to carve a substantial open ground figure without destroying the dominant bar mass.
Align the open side to the program-frame access side so the void responds coherently to the verified frontage.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the pure cantilever public-threshold articulation with a void-forming operation so the verified frontage can read as occupied ground rather than a sealed object.
Bring the threshold articulation lower and closer to the accessible ground band to strengthen the entry/public edge response.
Neutralize the current horizontal push so the next projection can prioritize a carve/notch or court over a protruding sealed mass.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact mass in all four views, so it clears basic integrity, but the visible form is too sealed and too object-like for neighborhood living. The dominant bar is legible, yet the ground condition is weak: the blue frontage edge is not answered by a convincing public void, entry seam, or undercut, and the parcel relationship feels generic rather than oriented. The stepped/bent top adds some silhouette interest, but it behaves more like an abstract terraced object than an active street building with a usable public threshold. Compared with the references, it has some resonance with compact courtyard/terrace/cantilever logics, but it lacks the stronger carved open-space figure and access-led section that those precedents demonstrate. Program fit therefore fails the hard gate because the mass does not visibly support the required active ground edge and public-space logic.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise community mass with a clear central opening and strong upper-level bridge/void relationship.

warnings: Visible mass appears mostly sealed at ground level despite neighborhood_living requiring an active public threshold.
The blue frontage edge is not strongly converted into a court, notch, or entry seam.
Stepped roof/silhouette is coherent but still reads as a generic sculpted object rather than a clearly programmed section.
Parcel containment appears acceptable; failure is semantic/programmatic rather than boundary-based.
